messages:
michael: Heads-up — PR #9062 is blocked on flaky test `integration/db-connector::connectivity_shard` failing in parallel runs. Failing on Buildkite ~50% of the time.
sara: saw that earlier. CI log looks like a port bind conflict? stack trace shows EADDRINUSE right before the failure.
ben: @michael can you paste the failing log snippet? I want to see the env and flags used.
michael: sure — trimmed log:
```
2026-03-16T14:12:08Z ERROR test_runner: failed to start shard 3: listen tcp :54321: bind: address already in use
2026-03-16T14:12:08Z INFO test_runner: retrying 3/3
2026-03-16T14:12:09Z FATAL test_runner: test failed: integration/db-connector::connectivity_shard
```
ci-bot: Buildkite pipeline `pr/9062` — job `integration-tests` failed (exit 1). URL: https://buildkite.example/teams/redwood/pipelines/pr/9062/builds/78 :gear:
ben: looks like tests assume ephemeral port 54321 hard-coded in test harness. when tests run in parallel different shards pick same port.
dalia: that's consistent with the flake we saw in canary yesterday. I pushed a quick patch to use `0` (ephemeral) in the harness in my branch — but we need an owner to review and greenlight.
sara: @ben @dalia can one of you review the harness change? it's tiny. If we merge the fix, do we need a snapshot update anywhere?
ben: no snapshot changes — it's infra-only. I can review now. please tag `ci-retry` label if we want a rerun before merging.
michael: pinging for approvals — we have 2 approvals needed for infra touches. @dalia is author, so needs one more from infra approver.
dalia: added changeset: remove hardcoded 54321, use random available port and env override `TEST_BIND_PORT`.
ben: reviewing... small nit: can you add a comment explaining why `0` is used and add a quick unit test to assert the port returned > 0?
dalia: on it. will push in ~10m.
sara: one more process question — we have a release freeze window tomorrow morning (08:00-12:00 UTC). Is this urgent to get merged before freeze? michael: Not blocking release, but it should be merged before we scale up parallel integration shards tomorrow afternoon. If we don't, we'll have noisy CI.
ben: LGTM after the unit test. @michael after dalia pushes, can you trigger a rerun? we should wait for green and then I can approve.
michael: will do. tagging `ci-retry` and `infra-approve` in the PR.
ci-bot: buildkite: triggered rebuild #79 for pr/9062 by michael — running integration-tests.
ci-bot: buildkite: job `integration-tests` passed on run #79. :white_check_mark:
ben: approved. :thumbsup:
sara: approving as infra reviewer as well. merging allowed once CI is green and changelog ok.
michael: merged to main at 1852001425. thanks everyone — I'll monitor the pipeline for the next hour and revert if anything odd shows up. :eyes:
